info.name: generate-austrac-report
info.description: Manually trigger the generate-austrac-report edge function for a given AEST report date. The pg_cron schedule that would normally call this is currently commented out, so this must be invoked directly. Fill in the service_role_key and reportDate collection variables before sending.

variable.description: For the hosted rygjssczdoyvmumxmymc project, use the NEW-style sb_secret_... key (Project Settings → API → API Keys → Secret keys) — NOT the legacy JWT-format service_role key under the Legacy API Keys tab. Confirmed by hashing the runtime value of Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY'); the legacy JWT has correct role/ref claims but does not match and will 401.
AEST calendar date the transactions were completed on, YYYY-MM-DD. One call only picks up transactions completed on this single day.

header.description: Supabase's API gateway (Kong) checks this independently of the Authorization header the function itself validates. Missing it causes a 401 before the function code ever runs.

request.description: Requires `supabase start` + `supabase functions serve` running locally. Use the service_role key from `supabase status`.
